findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with describe permissions on the function and in the Terraform state/source control.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is deprecated and no longer receives security patches, leaving the function exposed to unpatched vulnerabilities.

findings.issue_category: missing encryption configuration for environment variables
findings.description: No KMS customer-managed key is specified for encrypting the environment variables, so sensitive values rely on the default service-managed key rather than an auditable, customer-controlled key.
